note: FROZEN UNSEEN TEST — do not open case evidence while designing G3, gates, or RepEng interventions. Score only after an intervention is frozen on temporal-family-dev. Same predicate as lab. Synthetic notes only. Ids TFT_* are test-only; no overlap with temporal-family-dev wording.

cases.why: First-line ABVD response then progression and switch — not a contradiction.
cases.evidence: Classical Hodgkin lymphoma: first-line ABVD for three cycles with interim PET Deauville 2, then Deauville 5 progression at cycle 5. ABVD discontinued for progression; started Brentuximab-based second-line therapy.

cases.why: Initial SD on first-line then clear progression and regimen change.
cases.evidence: Metastatic clear-cell RCC on first-line axitinib/pembrolizumab: restaging after two cycles showed stable disease. Scan at month 5 showed new pulmonary nodules meeting progression criteria. First-line discontinued for progression; switched to cabozantinib.

cases.why: Response then relapse on first-line TKI — temporal sequence, not contradiction.
cases.evidence: Chronic myeloid leukemia: first-line imatinib achieved major molecular response by month 6, then BCR-ABL rose with hematologic relapse at month 14. Imatinib stopped for failure; switched to dasatinib.

cases.why: Possible progression later confirmed; first-line stopped for confirmed failure.
cases.evidence: Soft-tissue sarcoma on first-line doxorubicin: week-6 note flagged possible new soft-tissue mass. Confirmatory MRI ten days later documented unequivocal progressive disease. Doxorubicin stopped for confirmed progression; second-line ifosfamide planned.

cases.why: Early imaging negative for progression; later positive — sequence, not contradiction.
cases.evidence: Gastric adenocarcinoma on first-line FOLFOX: CT after cycle 2 showed no progression. CT after cycle 5 showed new peritoneal deposits. FOLFOX discontinued for progression; started paclitaxel/ramucirumab.

cases.why: Possible progression only; confirmatory imaging pending — must not AUTO failure.
cases.evidence: Melanoma on first-line nivolumab cycle 4: possible new subcutaneous nodule on exam. Biopsy and staging PET pending; no regimen change until results return.

cases.why: Stopped first-line for toxicity while disease controlled — not therapy failure.
cases.evidence: Ovarian cancer on first-line carboplatin/paclitaxel: CA-125 falling and imaging stable. Paclitaxel held for grade 3 hypersensitivity. Plan alternate taxane partner; no progression documented.

cases.why: Later toxicity after early tolerance; disease still responding — not first-line failure.
cases.evidence: Urothelial carcinoma on first-line gemcitabine/cisplatin: cycles 1–2 well tolerated with radiographic response. Cycle 3 complicated by febrile neutropenia requiring admission. Cisplatin held for toxicity; disease still responding without progression.

cases.why: Same workup denies vs documents completed first-line — true contradiction.
cases.evidence: Allogeneic transplant intake: patient reports never receiving systemic chemotherapy for AML. Same-day leukemia addendum: completed two cycles of first-line 7+3 with subsequent refractory blasts; proceed to donor search.

cases.why: Denies prior systemic therapy vs documents completed first-line R-CHOP.
cases.evidence: Second-opinion consult (3 Feb 2025): patient states no prior systemic therapy for mantle-cell lymphoma. Outside records uploaded same day: completed six cycles of first-line R-CHOP with subsequent progression on PET.

cases.why: Ongoing first-line with response; no failure event.
cases.evidence: MDS: currently on first-line azacitidine cycle 3 day 5. Counts improving; marrow planned after cycle 4. No progression documented.

cases.why: Ongoing first-line with continued response; no failure.
cases.evidence: HER2+ breast cancer: currently receiving first-line THP (taxane/trastuzumab/pertuzumab) cycle 4. Imaging shows ongoing partial response. Plan to complete planned cycles; no progression documented.
